item.title: No One Starts Again After 13 Years. I Did.
item.description:
I have a CS degree. Then I stayed home, and the few years I’d planned turned into thirteen.

When I decided to come back, someone told me plainly: no one starts working 13 years after graduating.

I believed them for a while. That’s the part I want to talk about.

What I had to relearn

Almost everything with a version number. The tools, the languages people actually used, the way teams shipped. Thirteen years is a long time in this industry. I re-taught myself from scratch, one evening at a time, and somewhere along the way I also finished a second major, in Accounting, before choosing CS again.
